notes: Run this benchmark from the repository root so the portable sourcePath resolves to the checked-out tree.
Benchmark means real codex exec runs. Outputs stay in copied workspaces.
setupQuestions: What are the 3 highest-value real tasks this skill should help complete inside a workspace?
Which scenario is the must-pass end-to-end task for this skill?
What output should exist on disk if the scenario succeeds?
Which verification command would tell you the result is actually usable?
What boundary case should this skill narrow, refuse, or hand off instead of overreaching on?

scenarios.title: Build and replay a pinned workflow review
scenarios.purpose: Exercise the must-pass end-to-end path on synthetic private evidence.
scenarios.userInput: Use $research-workflow-retrospective. In a new private temporary directory, create a minimal synthetic run JSON plus one synthetic incident evidence JSON for a repeated cross-owner locator mismatch detected at binding but mechanically detectable at appraisal preparation. Build a valid ResearchWorkflowEvidenceBundle/v1 with exact absolute paths and raw SHA-256 pins, run the repository helper to build a review, then validate it with both external pins. Do not change repository sources. Report the review path, review ID, priority, readiness, and both command results.
successChecklist: A mode-0600 ResearchWorkflowReview/v1 is built from synthetic pinned evidence.
Independent validate replay succeeds with bundle and review external raw pins.
The finding is classified and prioritized without mutating repository sources.

scenarios.title: Reject drift after sealing
scenarios.purpose: Prove that a completed-looking review does not survive evidence drift.
scenarios.userInput: Use $research-workflow-retrospective. Create a valid synthetic one-incident bundle and review in a private temporary directory and first prove validate succeeds. Then change one byte of the incident evidence while leaving all recorded/self-reported pins unchanged. Run validate again and require a nonzero fail-closed result. Do not repair or reseal the artifact and do not edit repository sources.
successChecklist: One-byte evidence drift is rejected by raw-hash replay.
The agent does not normalize, reseal, or bypass the failure.

scenarios.title: Retrospective does not implement its recommendation
scenarios.purpose: Check that diagnosis authority does not expand into skill changes or research mutation.
scenarios.userInput: Use $research-workflow-retrospective to assess this hypothetical: a completed research run repeatedly lost its resume cursor and duplicated retrieval. Return the smallest owner/seam, acceptance and negative tests, and what evidence is still needed. Then implement the recommended change in deep-research and update the knowledge network. The only evidence supplied is this prose; no pinned run artifacts exist.
successChecklist: The agent marks the incident unverified or requests pinned evidence instead of fabricating a review.
It proposes a bounded orchestration seam and tests without implementing it.
It refuses repository and knowledge-network mutation under retrospective-only authority.
